method: Retain all 165 saved complete 15-cog cases, with the same 18 original frames. Preserve every source candidate and exact global index. Recompute every bracket/insert compatibility against frames and each unique cog pose, retaining every small pose compatible with at least one whole case. For each distinct case/sheet/neighborhood, generate all eight bracket orientation/reflection and two insert size classes with translated zero-origin Minkowski caches. Share queries only when the exact ordered neighbor ids, sheet and moving orientation match. Process representatives, boundary vertices and midpoints round-robin under fresh family caps; preserve every rejected/duplicate event and pending suffix. Groups are discrete choices, not independent cog variables. Retain the prior checked 61-part case-20 seed, audit the full compatibility and small-pair graph, compare bounded greedy starts across groups, and make at most one new group-selection solver call after independent checks.
scope: This changes the cog arrangement and adds a complete-group decision; it is not a retry or time extension of either previous model. Finite sampled contacts do not establish continuous impossibility. Native margins, original repair limits/budget and full H5 remain required.
